title: Pill King Gu He Joins
summary: Medusa rescues Xiao Yan from the two remaining Mulan elders and they hide until the search passes. He gives her the Three Beast Savage Skill and the other Mulan techniques for the Snakemen Clan, and she offers him Yan Luo Tian's secret Gold Geese Sect method for a Flying Dou Skill with giant wings. Elsewhere, Xun Er learns that the Hall of Souls took Yao Lao, sends Mr. Ling to look for the Hall, and hears her clan will search the Xiao Clan in the Jia Ma Empire for a key. Fa Ma suggests winning Pill King Gu He for the Yan Alliance's Pill Hall with a Pill Tower recommendation. Gu He demands a pill-refining contest, loses to Xiao Yan, and joins the Pill Hall. A message from Little Fairy Doctor about Hall of Souls members sends Xiao Yan toward the Chu Yun Empire. Zi Yan wants to come along, and the Snakemen Grand Commander blames Xiao Yan for endangering Medusa and attacks him.
